delivery_evidence.captured_on_note: The capture date of the GUI and Mail evidence (the reference captures keep their own dates in references.json). gui.cjs, mail.cjs and regenerate.cjs take it from --date, else from the day of the run in UTC, so a regeneration on another day without --date changes it in gui/run.json, gui/README.md, mail/demo.json, mail/README.md and the evidence index, and with them the package digest.

reference_screenshots.source: Internet Archive (web.archive.org) copies of the reference product's public help, FAQ and caregiver pages, because its site refuses requests from outside the United States; no store, account or sign-in pages; reviewer agreement pending
reference_screenshots.details: the product, original URLs, the refusal message, labels, archive URLs, dates, masks, sizes and hashes are in the index and the manifest
reference_screenshots.snapshot_choice: For each page, the most recent snapshot before 2026-11-18 that the archive index lists with HTTP 200 and an HTML page; the tool checks this against the index before capturing and stops if a later one has appeared.
workflows: Fills, insurance claims and plan requests
Pickup by someone else and cancellation
reference_screenshots.redactions: phone numbers and e-mail addresses in a captured region; the regions show no names, addresses, prescription, member or card numbers, dates of birth or free text
reference_screenshots.repeatable: not byte-reproducible: the captures depend on the Internet Archive answering, and an archived script that fails to load can change how a page renders. reference.cjs compares each capture with the committed manifest before writing anything and stops, keeping the committed files, when the rendering mode (the page as it renders, or content revealed by setting its opacity to 1) or the size (width, height, scale) differs; --update replaces such captures after they are checked by eye. A capture with unchanged bytes keeps its committed captured_on.
reference_screenshots.rules_test: node --test apps/mendwell-pharmacy/evidence/tools/reference.test.cjs (5 tests with stubbed captures: a changed rendering mode and a changed size are refused with nothing replaced, unchanged captures keep their date, --update replaces a changed capture with the --date given, an unknown option or a bad date is refused before the archive is asked)

gui_sequences.steps_from: The steps are those of tests/web.browser.cjs, run unchanged inside the recorder: each step's action, expected result and checks come from that file, and every check it passes is listed with the step.
gui_sequences.per_step: action, expected result, the checked element (outlined in the screenshot), the test's own reading of the App state and every record changed since the previous step from the frozen Infra MCP state, the MCP calls the recorder lists for the step (every write, preview, Agent, Infra and forced call and every refused or failed read with its status and version; page reads answered with status ok, successful tool discoveries and inspector snapshots are owned but not listed), version, virtual time, the checks passed, screenshot
gui_sequences.supplied_replies: replies the test supplied or changed with Playwright route.fulfill are labelled injected, relayed or altered; an injected reply carries reached_host false
gui_sequences.reached_host: calls that failed on purpose carry reached_host: false when dropped before they reached the Web Host, true when the reply was dropped after Mendwell committed; steps_that_submit_writes counts only steps with a write or forced call whose reached_host is not false

run_level_checks.check: No JavaScript errors and no console or CSP errors beyond the induced network failures and refusals
No JavaScript errors and no console or CSP errors beyond the induced refusals

outline_check.rule: Every step names the element it checks; it must be on the page and on screen, and after the screenshot the PNG is decoded and points every 3 px along each side of the outline (3 px wide, 2 px outside the element), leaving out 12 px at each rounded corner, are sampled: at least one side must have 8 or more points inside the image, 80% or more of them in the outline colour #d9480f (each channel within 24); a side can be off screen or covered by a neighbouring pane when the element is larger than the view

gui_sequences.capture_point: each step ends at its last check; restoring state for later steps is part of the next step, so the screenshot shows the state the step asserts
gui_sequences.reproducibility: software rasterization on one thread, screenshots with animations disabled, request IDs from a counter kept in a cookie, capture date only; two consecutive runs of regenerate.cjs with the same --date gave byte-identical files in gui/

stages.local_commit: Mendwell commits and appends a notice to its own log
stages.receiver_commit: committed Router receipt and the record in the recipient's Mail account

mail_demonstration.repeatable: two consecutive runs of regenerate.cjs with the same --date gave byte-identical files in mail/

app_load_digest.algorithm: SHA-256 over each file's package-relative path, a NUL byte and its bytes, in path order (the verifier's digestTree applied to the included files)

app_limits: Mendwell returns only each fill's latest plan request, without its note or the plan's reasons
No Agent read returns the App's current time or a card's state, so the Account page does not mark an expired card; the App refuses a payment with it (payment_failed)

distinct_dates.basis: Counted over the records loaded into the App (dataset/full.json), which Agents and Infra read back.
